sources.release: Gaia DR3 / gaiadr3.gaia_source / reference epoch J2016.0
sources.acquisition: SELECT source_id,ref_epoch,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,pmra,pmdec,radial_velocity FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source; full export is not downloaded by this fixture build
sources.historical_attribution_guidance: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; use release-specific credits and papers. Official index states CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO; full policy fetch returned 451. Production use not approved.
sources.coverage: DR3 observed sources; survey selection, missing astrometry/radial velocities and crowded/faint coverage are not complete galaxy truth. This file is synthetic and represents no real star.
sources.uncertainty: Retain parallax errors, negative/missing parallax and missing proper/radial motion; do not invert noisy parallax into certain distance. U07/U09 own selection and inference.

sources.release: Frozen Horizons API response; signature and model metadata retained in JSON
sources.historical_attribution_guidance: Credit NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics, Horizons, retrieval date and actual model/version. Public query access does not approve all downstream redistribution terms.
sources.coverage: Earth center 399, solar-system barycenter 500@0; two vector epochs 2000-01-01 through 2000-01-02; KM-S, ICRF frame plane, TDB. Snapshot is not an ephemeris pack.
sources.uncertainty: Preserve service header/model, exact validity and units. Response has no full state covariance; no precision or long-range validity inferred. U08/U14 own conversion/evaluation.

sources.historical_attribution_guidance: Credit NASA Exoplanet Archive/Caltech/NASA Exoplanet Exploration Program, Christiansen et al. (2025), and original per-record literature. Retain pl_refname; do not treat contributed data as blanket public-domain approval.
sources.coverage: PS default_flag=1 for Proxima Cen b only; one self-consistent literature parameter row, not PSCompPars mixed references or a full observed planet inventory.
sources.uncertainty: Preserve asymmetric signed errors, nulls, Gaia identifiers and original references. No zero-fill, host cross-match, unit/frame conversion or inferred orbit in U06.
